title: Marketing Assistant
description:
Berry Recruitment are NOW hiring for a committed and experienced Marketing Assistant to work for a company in Didcot, Oxfordshire

Role: Marketing Assistant

Salary: 35,000.00 per annum

Location: Didcot, Oxfordshire

Hours: Monday - Friday, 9am - 5pm

Key Responsibilities of the Marketing Assistant:
- Planning, creating, and uploading varied and engaging content regularly to our website and managed social media channels.
- Overseeing channel interactions and replying/building the community online.
- Analysing and reporting on trends and good/bad posts with a view to improving our output month to month.
- Maintaining our website and updating product/brand listings.
- Managing our external email communications.
- Supporting our wider marketing activities.

About you:
- Successful applicants should have good experience or knowledge in multi-channel, multi-brand social media management and good web strategy, ideally some experience with META analytics and handling of monthly budgets.
- You should also have an engaging writing style for times when body text and video scripts are required, and an awareness of the impact your interactions can have on the appearance of the company.
- A keen interest in consumer electronics and knowledge of design tools is preferred, but not essential.

No candidate will meet every single desired qualification we have listed. If your experience looks a little different but you think you can role; value to the role, we'd love to learn more about you!"

For more information and to apply, contact the Oxford branch of Berry Recruitment - (phone number removed) or click 'Apply Now' to submit your application.

We are committed to fair and inclusive recruitment. All applicants will be considered on the basis of their skills, experience, qualifications and ability to perform the role, and no applicant will be treated less favourably because of a protected characteristic under the Equality Act 2010.

title: Marketing Assistant/office assistant
description:
Role: Office/ Marketing Assistant

Company: Bruce Hopkins
Location: Shenington, Oxfordshire
Hours: Part-time preferred, with the potential for full-time hours

About Bruce Hopkins:

Bruce Hopkins Ltd is an established family-run business based at Shenington Airfield, near Banbury, Oxfordshire, with over 50 years of experience in the agricultural, groundcare and construction machinery industries.

We sell new and used machinery, supply parts, and provide servicing and maintenance for a wide range of equipment. We work with leading manufacturers, including Polaris, Bobcat and Milwaukee, supporting our customers with quality products and reliable after-sales service.

We are looking for an enthusiastic and organised Office & Marketing Assistant to join our team, supporting the day-to-day running of the business while helping to maintain and grow our website, social media and online presence.

About the Role:

You will be responsible for:
- Answering telephone calls and handling general enquiries,
- Managing our social media channels,
- Creating engaging content to promote the business and the products we offer. This will include writing blogs and updating content on our website.
- Helping to organise and promote company events, including our annual Ride & Drive events, as well as supporting the team at external events and shows such as Moreton Show.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys a varied role and is happy to get involved in all aspects of the business. You will work closely with the team, gaining knowledge of our products and industry, with manufacturer training and support available where required.

Required:
- Able to commute to Shenington
- Good knowledge of social media
- Confident answering phones and responding to emails

Hours: 3/4 days a week, with the potential for full-time hours

19 days holiday

title: Marketing Manager - FTC
description:
Marketing Manager

6-Month FTC / Interim (Day Rate Considered)

Immediate or short-notice availability is highly desirable.

Are you a creative, commercially minded Marketing professional who loves bringing consumer brands to life?

The Advocate Group is excited to be partnering with an established FMCG business looking for an experienced Marketing Manager to take ownership of a high-profile brand development project.

This is an exciting opportunity to shape the next chapter of a consumer brand, bringing fresh thinking, creativity, and commercial expertise to strengthen its positioning and drive growth.

We're looking for someone who combines strategic brand thinking with hands-on execution, turning consumer insights into compelling brand propositions and impactful marketing activity.

Key Responsibilities:
- Take ownership of an exciting consumer brand project, shaping its positioning, marketing strategy and commercial development.
- Use consumer and shopper insights to identify opportunities, strengthen the brand proposition and drive consumer engagement.
- Bring fresh, creative thinking to brand communications, packaging, digital marketing and activation to build a distinctive and engaging brand.
- Work closely with external creative agencies to develop compelling brand assets, campaigns and marketing initiatives.
- Develop and execute a clear go-to-market strategy, working alongside commercial teams to drive retail engagement and growth.
- Lead cross-functional project delivery, managing timelines, key milestones and stakeholders to ensure successful execution.
- Build strong relationships with senior stakeholders, confidently presenting recommendations, influencing decisions and driving projects forward.

About You:
- Strong background in Brand/Commercial/Tade Marketing within FMCG, with experience in consumer brand development.
- Proven experience leading brand launches, shaping brand strategy, developing consumer propositions, and delivering successful marketing initiatives.
- A creative, consumer-led marketer who can translate insights into engaging brand propositions and impactful campaigns.
- Strong commercial awareness, with an understanding of brand performance, P&L, and route-to-market strategies.
- Excellent project management and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to independently lead cross-functional initiatives through to execution.

If you're an experienced marketer who enjoys combining creativity, strategic thinking and commercial expertise to make a real impact, I'd love to hear from you!

Please get in touch with Emma or click "Apply Now" to be considered for this vacancy.
